svg.title: More games per step is almost free
svg.desc: Decode step time against games running at once (11 Oct ladder). The dashed line is what it would cost if every game added the same time as at 13 games. 32 games take 38.5 ms per step against 24.0 ms for 13: 2.5x the games for 1.6x the time. We shipped 32, not 48: past 32 the history cache per game got too small and the offline evaluation score dropped.
